findingClass: /api/ipos/<slug> (or the /ipos/<slug> page, same resolution path) resolves an unknown slug to a DIFFERENT IPO instead of 404ing
failThreshold: any of 3 nonsense slugs (never a real row) does not return 404, OR a real currently-live slug does not resolve to itself
unverifiableWhen: a request is unreachable (timeout/network), or there is no LISTED row to run the positive case against
note: T-485 (2026-09-07): findBySlugWithFallback used to accept any best-scoring Fuse.js fuzzy match with no floor, so 'karamtara-engineering-ltd' (no row on prod) resolved to 'Sumax Engineering Ltd.' purely on the shared word 'engineering' (measured score 0.44, 56% similarity). Fixed by resolving only via the slug-redirect table, an exact normalized company-name match, or a fuzzy match at or above an 85% similarity floor (measured: a genuine one-typo pair scores 15%, comfortably inside; the karamtara/sumax collision at 44% is rejected by more than double the margin) — everything else 404s, with the miss negative-cached per #344.
